description: Kincardine Gardens by bus stopT1	Lime x 1	(Tilia spp)	This 12m previously reduced lime tree has missed several pruning cycles due to its proximity to the bus stop and TfL's unwillingness to suspend the bus stop. Suggested work:- crown reduction- reduce back to previous reduction points,equating to a reduction of 4m, leaving furnishing growth- retain 50% of internal fine branch structureKincardine Gardens by green gateT2	Lime x 1	(Tilia spp) This 11m previously reduced lime tree is due its cyclical prune.
